name: Application Lifecycle & Windowing
mandatoryCriteria: Application launches in < 1.5s
Window bounds restored atomically from settings.json
Zero white flashes on startup
Single-instance lock redirects secondary instances cleanly

name: Desktop Navigation & Layout
subsystem: Navigation Sidebar, App Header, Hash Routing
mandatoryCriteria: Sidebar collapses/expands smoothly without clipping content
All top-level routes reachable via single click
Responsive margin adjusts on viewport change
Hotkey '?' triggers shortcuts modal

name: Multi-Media Section Hub
mandatoryCriteria: Root route #/ renders hub with Anime, Manga, Novels, Movies
Clicking any card transitions to section without page reload

name: Anime Discovery & Catalog
mandatoryCriteria: Hero carousel renders active banner, title, synopsis
Catalog filters re-query correctly
Details page displays episode list and metadata

name: Real-Time Video Player (CinePlayer)
mandatoryCriteria: Video playback starts within 2s of selection
Controls (play, seek, volume, fullscreen) respond to clicks and keys
Server fallback initiates automatically on 404/500 errors
Subtitles synchronize with video playhead

name: WebGPU Neural Video Enhancement
mandatoryCriteria: Physical WebGPU adapter acquired without CPU fallback
Anime4K WGSL shader executes without compute pipeline crashes
Draggable split slider updates comparison clip-path from 5% to 95%
Watchdog auto-degrades to fast preset if latency > 50ms

name: Manga Catalog & Reader
mandatoryCriteria: Manga catalog renders cards with title and covers
Chapter reader loads image pages cleanly
Keyboard navigation advances chapters

name: Light Novel Catalog & Reader
mandatoryCriteria: Novel catalog lists titles with chapter counts
Reader renders text typography with customizable themes
Graceful error recovery on upstream timeout

name: Movies & TV Shows
mandatoryCriteria: Movies homepage loads trending movies from TMDB
Movie stream player resolves stream and begins playback

name: Live Search Modals
mandatoryCriteria: Hotkey '/' or search bar opens modal
Queries return debounced results within 400ms
Clicking result navigates to details page and dismisses modal

name: HLS Offline Downloader
subsystem: Download Queue, FFmpeg Muxing & Disk Safety
mandatoryCriteria: Download initiates from details or downloads page
Segments fetch concurrently via proxy and merge into MP4 on disk
Offline player streams downloaded file directly via file://
Path traversal protection bounds writes strictly inside downloadDir

name: User Profile & Watchlist
mandatoryCriteria: Profile page displays watch statistics and history
Watchlist status changes persist to local store and AniList

name: Community & Watch Parties
mandatoryCriteria: Community rooms connect to realtime WebSocket
Messages render in stream without duplicate keys

name: RPG Ascension & Gamification
mandatoryCriteria: Daily streak claim button awards XP and updates streak counter
Rank progression persists in localStorage

name: Universal GPU Acceleration
mandatoryCriteria: configureGpuSwitches applies platform-specific Chromium flags
Multi-GPU routing switch passes cleanly
gpu:getDiagnostics returns structured state
UI reflects real-time decoder target and graphics backend

name: Desktop Settings & Health Center
mandatoryCriteria: All settings save atomically and validate against Zod schema
Run Diagnostics measures latency to AniList, GitHub, and Cloud CDN
Active playback guard suppresses disruptive actions during video

name: OTA Production Updater
mandatoryCriteria: Queries GitHub releases API securely without exposing tokens
Verifies SHA256 blockmap hash before applying update
Safe error handling when offline or up-to-date

name: Theme Engine & Persistence
mandatoryCriteria: Theme toggle switches between Dark and Light
HTML root class updates immediately without white flash
Setting persists across restart

name: Security & SSRF Shield Gate
mandatoryCriteria: ShieldGate prevents unauthorized embedding
Internal IP addresses and private loopbacks blocked on stream proxy
Zero secrets leaked in client bundles or application logs

name: Fault Isolation & Boundaries
mandatoryCriteria: React Error Boundary catches unexpected render errors
Try Again and Return Home recover gracefully
WebGPU device loss fails over to standard video without crash
